scope.purpose: Falsify event-order shortcut: can learned causal factual write admission predict future unseen executed action consequences after interleaved interference?

hypothesis.candidate: Four-trainable-parameter content-sensitive gate on the original P65 16x16 fast-weight outer-product residual update, with no event-index input
hypothesis.null: Improvement in P66 came from chronology, data marginals, undertrained conventional baselines, or differing compute rather than transferrable factual memory selectivity
hypothesis.mechanism: Gate may learn to prioritize repeated causally predictive associations without seeing future query identity, evaluator relevance, or time index

training_world.order: fresh uniformly randomized interleaving per world; condition on content, never phase; audit balanced relevance across time bins
training_world.causal_generation: Per-world independent action-effect mappings; observed effects emitted only after an executed simulated action. Same broad key/effect marginals for repeated target and one-off distractor families; no explicit target flag in model input
training_world.readout: One genuinely executed simulated final query after all factual writes; label is measured consequence and is revealed only to the loss/evaluator, not an earlier write decision

unfamiliar_ood.change: new mapping seed, unseen rotations and noise scales, length and distractor load; target events uniformly interleaved with distractors
unfamiliar_ood.report: Measure cold retention and final action-consequence prediction separately; no OOD selection or OOD-driven checkpoint/threshold changes

controls.phase: No timestep, remaining length, first-half/second-half flag or role label as gate input; detect and fail any target-vs-distractor position imbalance > 0.05 in 4 equally sized time bins
controls.shortcut: An index-only nuisance classifier's held-out role accuracy must not exceed 0.55; if it does, label as invalid source design
controls.wrong_credit: Independently permuted factual action keys paired with actual effects; compare same training budget and delayed query
controls.orthogonal: Negative distractors orthogonal to query subspace must not materially change correct prediction under identical factual-target stream
controls.cold_restore: Checkpoint model weights plus factual 16x16 state at midpoint; bitwise equality of resumed versus continuous readout on deterministic CPU

arms.candidate: P66-174 four-feature sigmoid residual gate without time-index input; three distinct seeded nonzero gate initializations
arms.strongest_trained: Conventional GRU with 256-dimensional recurrent factual state and query-conditioned head; ensure actual query is unavailable until final readout; report trainable parameter and FLOPs mismatch instead of claiming parameter equivalence
classical: random write gate matched to candidate FIT write fraction
negative: privileged evaluator oracle strictly diagnostic; excluded from best baseline

training.init: Seed all trainable parameters with separate per-arm/per-seed torch generators; for gate theta sample uniform[-0.05,0.05] not all-zero; record per-seed parameter SHA256 and verify all three differ
training.selection: Select and freeze best checkpoint using validation only, at first registered patience stop; no OOD lookahead; if reaching maximum steps without patience or valid convergence evidence, training_not_qualified
training.conventional_competence: Every trained GRU baseline must reduce validation query MSE >=15% versus a zero-state predictor, and show a precommitted validated early stop; otherwise the scientific comparison is FAIL/UNQUALIFIED, even if candidate wins
training.fairness: Exactly the same FIT/VAL worlds, actions, observed effects, supervised final-query outcomes, batch indices, and action opportunities for all arms; persistent factual state compared at 256 floats; report distinct trainable parameters, exact training/inference wall-clock, FLOPs estimates and peak memory, and do not claim whole-process cost matching when unsupported

frozen_decisions.dev_primary_metric: MSE of held-out executed final-query observed consequences, per world, on previously unseen OOD-DEV worlds
frozen_decisions.required_gain: In all three independent initialized runs, learned gate OOD-DEV MSE <=0.90 times strongest eligible nonprivileged comparator on same worlds
frozen_decisions.confidence: For each run, paired 5000-world-bootstrap resamples with seed 970401 must give a positive lower bound on reduction in MSE versus strongest comparator at 95% percentile confidence
frozen_decisions.causal_negative: In each run, wrong-action-credit model OOD-DEV MSE >=1.20 times correct-credit candidate; rate-matched random gating >=1.15 times candidate
controls_required: all source/balance and index-only leakage checks
all three competent early-stopped conventional baselines
report process time/FLOPs even on failure
